method: ThreadPoolExecutor over observed_region_masks; 1, 2, 4 workers; cv2 threads=1; OMP/MKL threads=1
sample: First 8 Train Seen raw episodes, trajectory fractions 0/.2/.4/.6, positive height only; native 384 RGB/depth and canonical 784 candidate grid; 32 frames
scope: CPU region-mask computation only, actual renders prepared before timing; no GPU encoding measured
equality: Each mask and quality array exactly equal to single-thread reference
limitations: One timing per configuration, not a statistically stable benchmark

First 8 episodes do not represent all maps or visibility patterns
decision: Do not replace active preparation with this slower thread-only approach; leave existing cache and training configuration unchanged
